messages:
Olivia (PM): Quick check — PRD draft for observability console (retention + trace UX lite) is up: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/PRD-9876
Olivia (PM): Please scan acceptance criteria + edge cases. Need engineering sign-off by EOD Thu. TL;DR: retention tiering, trace sampling toggle, dashboard export flow. @sandeep @emily :eyes:
Sandeep: skimmed the doc. Main risk = storage cost explosion from cold retention. Need a hard cost budget and a migration/backfill plan.
Sandeep: Suggested ACs (quick):
```
- No retention change increases a customer's monthly bill >5% without explicit opt-in.
- Backfill for new retention tiers completes within 7 days for <=1000 orgs.
- Cold-archive retrieval latency documented and tested.
```
Sandeep: Also: config example for backend teams:
```yaml
retention:
  tier: standard
  days: 30
  cold_archive: true
```
Emily (Design): UX notes — retention selector should default to "standard 30d" and show an inline cost estimate + short tooltip about tradeoffs. Edge case: if user switches from long->short retention, show purge preview and require confirmation.
Emily (Design): For trace sampling UI, show a per-service sampling override (not just global). Keep controls collapsed by default.
Dan (SRE): +1 to everything above. Add rollout constraints: canary to 5% orgs, monitor storage and ingestion metrics for 48h. AC: ability to rollback within 30 minutes and resume old retention window.
Dan (SRE): Need clear runbook for support: how to rehydrate recently-purged data (if possible) and how to validate canary health.
Tara (Design): quick mock uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/obs-retention-lite — includes inline warning states and the export-to-S3 permission modal.
Tara (Design): Small edgecase — mobile view: selector needs a stacked layout, not a horizontal slider.
k8s-deploy-bot: PRD saved as version v1.2 by Olivia (PM) — snapshot sha256: a3f4c9b2
Olivia (PM): Thanks — I'll fold these ACs in. Planning to create three tickets: ENG-312 (retention backend + cost guardrails), ENG-313 (trace sampling + per-service overrides), DESIGN-77 (UX polish + warnings). Owners assigned, draft rollout plan attached in the PRD.
Olivia (PM): Action items: ENG owners to post performance estimate + cost delta by Tue, DESIGN to deliver final mocks by Wed, SRE to propose canary metrics and runbook by Wed. I'll sync Thu 10:00 for final sign-off. :thumbsup:
Sandeep: I'll put initial cost delta numbers in ENG-312 by tomorrow.
Emily (Design): I'll update mocks and add the purge confirmation microcopy.
Dan (SRE): I'll draft the rollback/runbook and basic PromQL checks for canary monitoring.
Olivia (PM): Perfect. If anyone sees a hard blocker (compliance/perf) before Wed, ping me directly. Otherwise we'll move to implementation next sprint. :rocket:
